subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode zero-envelope report until live current-main envelope proof identifies the drop boundary?
rationale: The code and tests prove handler support, but only live Slack diagnostics can decide whether the remaining problem is Slack/Bolt delivery, OpenClaw account filtering, authorization, or a broader socket liveness failure.

options.title: Keep Reaction Report Canonical
options.body: Use this issue for reaction add/remove zero-envelope evidence and link broader Slack Socket Mode reports as overlaps until diagnostics prove a shared root cause.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Socket Issue
options.body: Move the remaining investigation to the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery issue if maintainers can preserve the reaction-specific repro details there.

options.title: Tie To Liveness Work
options.body: Treat this as blocked by the zombie WSS investigation only if live logs show the Socket Mode connection stops delivering all event families, not only reactions.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction Report Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue for reaction add/remove zero-envelope evidence and link broader Slack Socket Mode reports as overlaps until diagnostics prove a shared root cause.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent authored the merged system-event routing fix referenced by the report and is tied to the latest release containing the current Slack reaction path.
